name: a credibility numeral and a radar sweep
looks: A large outline numeral fills most of the frame beside a short claim of years of experience, the scanline still ticking underneath. It hard-cuts to a circular radar-style sweep -- a ring with converging spoke lines -- under a short claim of hands-on, personal control.
build: Big DOM numeral (outline weight) beside a short phrase, hard-cut to an SVG/canvas radial fan (a dozen thin lines converging from a ring's edge to a point, sweeping or pulsing on the clock) under a second phrase; same HUD chrome and green line style throughout.
sound: A low confident swell under the numeral, a soft whirr under the radar sweep.
prompt: State a credibility figure (years of experience, a track record) as one big outline numeral beside a short claim, then cut to a radial sweep diagram -- spokes converging from a ring to a centre point -- under a claim of hands-on control. Both beats are proof moments: the number and the sweep both read as 'this is measured, not promised.'
